The list of affected roles is written nowhere: it is derived from what each module already has configured, so a newly added supporter role is recognised immediately.
  • ⏳ Close a channel "for two hours" and have it reopen by itself — eight new commands: +autolock, +autounlock, +autohide, +autounhide, and the "all channels" variant of each. +autolock #announcements 2h locks now and unlocks at the stated time, with nobody having to remember. The deadline is written to the database, not held by an in-memory timer: a channel closed on Friday evening does not stay closed all weekend because the bot restarted. And at expiry the bot restores the previous state — a channel that was already closed stays closed, instead of being opened by mistake.
  • 🎯 +permsalon — let a role use a command in ONE specific channel — "the host can run +clear in #giveaway, but not in #general". The permission is purely additive: it grants a right, it never removes one, from anyone. A permission set on a category applies to all of its channels. The list of delegable commands is closed and lives in the code — no setting can widen it: excluded are anything touching security or configuration, anything reaching beyond the channel where the command is typed (+purge … all wipes everywhere), and sanctions aimed at a person (a ban does not happen "in a channel").
  • 🙈 Ignore certain channels in channel surveillance — +antiupdate ignore #member-count: counters that rename themselves every ten minutes and temporary voice channels no longer fill the log. Ignoring a category covers all of its channels, including ones created later. Two safeguards: a burst deletion (3 channels in 1 minute) is logged no matter what — that is the signature of a nuke, and the exclusion list must not become the place to hide; and the anti-raid protections have no knowledge of this list, they keep counting and sanctioning every deletion.
  • 🧵 A thread opens by itself under every photo — +autothread #photos: every image posted gets its own thread, so reactions and opinions no longer drown the channel. A message without an image gets none — that is the point. The thread title is configurable ({user}, {sujet}), and tous mode opens a thread under every message if you prefer.
  • 🖼️ Images-only channel — +autothread onlypic on #photos: messages without an image are deleted, with a reminder that erases itself so it does not fill the channel in turn. Members who can manage messages are exempt — without that exception, writing the channel's own rules would be impossible.
  • 🐢 Slowmode in automatically created threads — +autothread lent 30 #photos: threads opened by the bot are born already in slowmode. Set at creation rather than afterwards: between the two there is a window where the thread is open without it, and that is exactly when a burst arrives.
  • 🎨 {MemberBanner} — the member's banner in custom messages — usable in the welcome message, the goodbye message and custom commands, alongside two new neighbours: {MemberPic} (avatar) and {ServerBoostsCount} (boost count). Discord does not ship the banner with the rest: it needs a separate request, which is made only when the message actually asks for it. A member with no banner yields empty text, never "undefined". And the variable list shown by +setwelcome, +setgoodbye and +custom is now derived from the real table — it can no longer advertise a variable that does not exist, nor forget one that was just added.
  • 📦 Surprise crates finally state their rarity — three rarities: 🎁 Normal (87 %, 30-79 XP), ✨ Rare (10 %, 120-199 XP) and 💎 Legendary (3 %, 300-499 XP plus a little aura). They already existed, but the rarity was only named when the crate appeared: on pickup you learned what you won without learning what you had opened. It is now announced at the moment of the claim (emoji, colour and name), including in the private reply to whoever solves a locked crate's riddle. The golden crate is now called Rare; record leaderboards are untouched.
  • 📋 Claimed crates finally go through the log system — their trace bypassed it and wrote straight to the general channel. It therefore ignored per-action routing (+setlogs routes), fed neither the daily digest nor the end-of-day summary, and had no retry on a network hiccup. Fixed, with the rarity, the reward and how the crate was opened (click or riddle) in the embed. Crates get their own routing key: they can go to a channel of their own, and unticking a surveillance category does not switch them off.
  • 📌 Pins become readable — Discord announces "X pinned a message" without saying which one and without linking anywhere. +pinlog on replaces that notice with an embed: who pinned, an excerpt of the message, its author and a direct link. Pins are compared against the ones already known, so a pin made while the bot was offline is found at the next change — and on restart. The very first pass over a channel records what is already there without publishing anything: enabling the module on a channel with forty pins does not publish forty. Destination configurable.
  • 🔒 +lockrole — freeze a role completely — a locked role can no longer be changed: not its name, not its permissions, not its colour, not its separate display, not its mentionability. Any change is undone within the second and logged with its author. This is the answer to the quiet manipulations: renaming "Moderator" to "Member", or stripping a permission from it without anything announcing it. +unlockrole releases the lock. A role sitting above the bot is refused rather than accepting a decorative lock.
  • ↩️ Turning verification off now cleans up — and can be undone — +setverify off only cleared the role: the channel stayed, with a "Verify" button that no longer granted anything, and no way for a newcomer to tell. The now-useless channel is deleted, and owners get an alert with a "That was a mistake — put it all back" button that recreates the channel in its original category, restores the role and reposts the panel. The three ways to disable it (command, +setup, wizard) finally follow the same path.
  • 🌐 +translate — translate a text, or the message you reply to — +translate en Bonjour tout le monde, or reply to a message with +translate es. Fifteen languages, written the way people actually write them (anglais, en, english). The source language is detected automatically. The free service used caps at 500 characters per translation: that is stated plainly when you exceed it, rather than splitting the text into pieces that would contradict each other. Answers cached for ten minutes, one translation every 3 seconds per server, and never a freeze: past 7 seconds without an answer, the bot says so and hands back control.
  • 👁️ +lastseen @member — when a member was last seen ACTIVE — last message, last counted minute of voice, or "in voice right now" when that is the case. This is not a last-connection time: Discord does not report that to anyone, and guessing it would require continuously receiving every member's status on every server. The bot does not ask for that. So the command shows what it based its answer on, and says it outright — "seen three days ago" does not mean "not connected for three days".
  • ⏰ Reminders now understand clock times — and daylight saving — on top of delays (+remind 1h …), you can write +remind 9h30 …, +remind demain 9h … or +remind 25/12 18:00 …. Those times are computed with the offset of the target date, not of the day you type the command: "15 November at 9am" scheduled in midsummer lands at 9am, not 10am. On the spring-forward night, a requested time that does not exist (the clock jumps from 2am to 3am) is flagged and pushed to the first valid instant instead of being silently moved. 9h on its own still means a 9-hour delay, as before.
  • 🗂️ Suggestions can now become FORUM posts — point +setsuggest #ideas at a forum channel and every +suggest creates a full post there: it can be debated in its own thread without polluting the others, votes 👍 / 👎 work exactly as before, and when staff decides, the post gets its tag (✅ Approved / ⛔ Rejected) and is then closed. The mode is inferred from the channel type — no extra setting that could one day disagree with the channel actually configured. Tags already present on your forum ("bug", "idea"…) are kept as they are, IDs included: no already-tagged post loses its tag.
  • 💜 The supporter voice channel now wears the bot's colours — it was called "💜 username", which said nothing about what it was and made it indistinguishable from an ordinary temporary voice channel. It becomes "💜 Soutien · username", in the same signature as the bot's other channels (🏆 trophy room, 🚩 reports): you read what the channel is for first, then whose it is — the useful order when scanning the voice list.
  • ⚖️ +punish setup finally shows the whole strike chain — punishment tiers on one side, thresholds buried in "Advanced settings" on the other, and nothing saying the latter feed the former: setting "5 strikes → ban" without knowing what counts as a strike is configuring half a mechanism. The panel now shows what generates a strike (scam, spam, mass mentions, links, banned words — with each one's real state) and then what strikes trigger. It also warns when no module feeds strikes while tiers are configured: taken separately the two screens looked fine — it is putting them side by side that reveals the gap. Thresholds can be set from either place with a single stored value: the panel's buttons literally call +setup's own code, so the two views cannot drift. +setup points back to +punish in return. (The old +punish setup, which applied the strict ladder at once, is still available via +punish setup strict and as a button in the panel.)
  • 🔔 Alert preferences join the setup assistant — +wizard now has an "Alert preferences" step in the Security group: how the bot flags an alert in the log channel (@everyone, @here, or the alert role, chosen by default). The button opens +alertconfig's own panel — not a copy — including "My personal settings", which stay private.
  • 🔧 +update now updates the CODE, not the packages — the command did not actually touch the code: it ran npm install <package>@latest on every dependency, then restarted. And @latest ignores the declared range: a ^12.11.1 did not prevent the next major version from being installed, rewriting package.json along the way. By default, +update now does a git pull of the code, runs the tests, then restarts — without touching a single package. Packages remain reachable through an explicit word, +update deps, which announces major version jumps before installing. Three safeguards on the pull: it refuses when changes are uncommitted (this folder is the production bot's working copy), fast-forward only (never a merge created behind your back), and no automatic rollback — the bot keeps running on the code already loaded, so there is no rush.
  • 💾 +backup now opens a menu — no syntax to memorise — the backup system was complete but entirely command-line: five subcommands, three scopes, a restore mode and two confirmations. Plain +backup now shows the state of all three scopes (full, roles + channels, messages) with their real counts and history, plus three buttons: Create (pick the scope), Restore (pick the version) and History. The subcommands are untouched: +backup roles, +backup list, +backup messages, +backup restore confirm do exactly what they did. The menu is limited to server owners, and restoring stays limited to bot owners — rechecked on every click, since a panel stays clickable long after it was opened.
  • ♻️ Click-through restore finally offers its mode — after choosing what happens to the bot's own channels (keep / delete / recreate), you now pick Smart, Simple or Purge. That choice existed on the command line, but the button flow silently applied the default: there was no way to fix a drifted channel or clean up without going back to the keyboard. The +backup menu and the automatic post-attack proposal share the same flow — same questions, same checks, same application. A button from an earlier version of the bot keeps working exactly as before.
  • ⏳ The bot catches up on commands typed while it was offline — an outage, someone types +bot, and the message just sits there unanswered: nobody knows whether it was seen. On return, the bot re-reads the channels and replies to the original message (a real Discord reply) with a note explaining the delay. Your message is never deleted. On everywhere by default, configurable with +rattrapage.

    The window has no time limit: a question asked three days ago still deserves its answer. Volume is the bound instead — at most 20 commands per server per restart, most recent first, and anything beyond that is announced rather than silently dropped. A plain restart (under 4 minutes of downtime) triggers nothing: without that floor, every deployment would replay commands.

    Only read-only commands are replayed (+bot, +level, +sanctions, +lastseen…), from a closed list written in the code that no setting can widen. Never destructive ones, never security or configuration, never games or economy — for those the person has usually retyped the command on return, and replaying would hand out the reward twice. Permissions are re-checked at catch-up time, not as of when the command was typed: anyone who left, was demoted or sanctioned in between gets nothing. And a server still under attack is skipped.

    🖱️ Button clicks cannot be caught up, and that is not a matter of effort: Discord only delivers an interaction over the gateway, never queues it, and offers no way to retrieve the ones you missed. The bot's panels stay valid — click again, it works.
  • 📺 +createur — announces a channel's new YouTube videos — follow up to 5 channels per server, choose the announcement channel and the mention (a role, @everyone, or none). Add a channel by link, @handle or ID: the bot works out the rest. On adding, its already-published videos are recorded without being announced — otherwise the first setup would post fifteen videos at once. A video is never announced twice, even if the feed reshuffles. Checked every 10 minutes, rotating across all servers, never more than 8 channels re-read per round.

    Twitch and TikTok are not included, and that is not an oversight. The Twitch API requires an application ID + secret (it answers 401 without one): a decision to make before adding it. TikTok offers no reliable free way to detect a publication — no feed, a page with no data, an oEmbed that errors. Rather than improvising on an unofficial third-party relay, this is stated plainly.
  • ✨ The setup assistant becomes readable — sixteen steps across four themes, and until now a row of sixteen identical squares as your only compass. Progress is now a gauge with a percentage (▰▰▰▰▰▱▱▱▱▱ 50 % · step 8/16 · 🏘️ Community 1/4): you know where you are, in the run and in the theme. The title gets lighter accordingly — it now carries only the theme.
  • 🏠 A table of contents for the assistant — a new button on every step: it shows all sixteen steps grouped by theme, ticked or not, and lets you jump straight to the one you want instead of clicking "Back" eight times. The ⚙️ "Detailed settings" button moved there: a step's button row is now pure navigation (back · next · skip · contents · close), and ⚙️ opens an entirely different panel anyway.
  • 🏁 The final summary finally says what was done — it used to announce "11/16 steps in place", which does not say which. It now lists by name what is in place and what is not yet, noting that none of it is mandatory. Technically, each step's state is no longer computed twice for the same screen, and theme positions are prepared once at startup rather than on every render.
  • 📖 +help finally speaks plain language — all 233 command explanations were read one by one, and 29 rewritten. The too-short ones said what without saying how: "Deletes messages in bulk" becomes "Deletes the channel's most recent messages at once (+clear 50) — Discord forbids erasing anything older than 14 days". Jargon is gone: no more "vanity URL" or "webhook" dropped without explanation. And the sprawling ones, unreadable in a list, were tightened without losing anything — +setup's went from 412 to 203 characters. No name, alias, category or behaviour changed: only the texts.
  • 👑 +createur moves into the owner's hands — the creator-notification command was open to any administrator: any of them could have a channel announced wherever they liked, with whatever mention they liked — including @everyone, on every upload. That is a shop-window decision for the server, not a moderation setting: it is now reserved for the server owner and the bot owners.
  • 🎭 New game — Make Me Laugh (+memegame): the same image for everyone, each player writes their caption in secret, then the channel votes for the funniest without knowing who wrote what. 3 to 10 players, several rounds on different images, authors revealed at the end of each round, then a final ranking with XP and aura. +memegame history keeps the server's hall of fame — the last 20 games and their winning caption. The anonymity is real: the order of entries is shuffled and the ballot carries only numbers, never the authors' identities.
  • 🔤 +prefix reset — back to the default prefix in one command. Handy after an unfortunate prefix: +prefix off literally set off as the prefix, and there was no obvious way back.
  • 🇬🇧 The bot starts speaking English — the 🇫🇷/🇬🇧 flag in the wizard and in +setup was purely decorative: the chosen language was saved, but no message ever read it. It now takes effect. The first screens are translated — permission refusals, the +help frame, the language screen — and the rest will follow in stages. A missing English translation never shows an error or technical text: the message simply falls back to French.

Une caisse légendaire fait son apparition 💎A legendary crate makes its appearance 💎7 août 2026 à 09:01

  • 💎 Une caisse légendaire, rare, avec un peu d'aura — aux caisses surprises s'ajoute un troisième palier : environ une caisse sur trente est légendaire. Elle donne beaucoup plus d'XP que la caisse dorée, et c'est la seule à contenir un peu d'aura. Volontairement peu : sur un serveur au maximum de caisses, cela représente moins de trente aura par jour, quand la roue quotidienne en distribue déjà des centaines à un seul joueur. C'est une surprise, pas une source de revenu.
  • 🔊 Les salons vocaux temporaires ne s'accumulent plus — avec le « Rejoindre pour créer », revenir dans le salon d'accueil depuis son propre salon vocal laissait celui-ci vide et jamais supprimé. Rien ne pouvait plus le nettoyer avant un redémarrage du bot. Répété, cela saturait la catégorie du salon d'accueil — et une fois pleine, plus aucun salon ne pouvait être créé pour personne. Le nettoyage se fait désormais dans tous les cas.
  • 🔒 +bug ne peut plus révéler ce qui doit rester caché — le panneau de signalement affiche « ta dernière commande » dans le salon. Il pouvait donc y republier le contenu d'un signalement (+report), désignant du même coup la personne qui l'avait envoyé et celle qu'il visait, ainsi que des commandes volontairement invisibles. Ces contenus ne sont plus mémorisés du tout.
  • 🔁 Le bouton « Rejouer » explique son refus, sans encombrer le salon — quand on reclique trop vite, le message d'attente n'est plus posté dans le salon mais affiché à toi seul. Cliquer en boucle ne remplit donc plus le fil de messages du bot.
  • ⏰ Les rappels restent accessibles à tout le monde — le nombre de rappels en attente par serveur est plafonné, et quelques personnes pouvaient à elles seules remplir ce plafond et priver les autres de +remind et +announce. Une part est maintenant réservée à ceux qui en ont peu : un gros utilisateur se limite lui-même avant de gêner qui que ce soit.
  • ⚡ L'affichage du rang est presque deux fois plus rapide — le calcul de ta place dans le classement (+level) interrogeait la base d'une façon qui l'obligeait à faire deux recherches puis à les fusionner. Réécrit, il n'en fait plus qu'une : 1,75 fois plus rapide, pour un résultat identique. Cela ne change pas la vitesse générale du bot, seulement celle des commandes qui affichent un rang.
  • 🎨 Deux commandes répondaient sans mise en forme — +base et +warhammer renvoyaient certains refus en texte nu, alors que le reste du bot les habille d'un encadré coloré. +warhammer allait jusqu'à afficher le même message des deux façons selon le chemin emprunté. C'est uniformisé.
  • 💎 A rare legendary crate, with a little aura — surprise crates gain a third tier: roughly one crate in thirty is legendary. It gives far more XP than the golden crate, and it is the only one containing a little aura. Deliberately little: on a server at its crate limit, that is under thirty aura a day, when the daily wheel already hands hundreds to a single player. It is a surprise, not an income.
  • 🔊 Temporary voice channels no longer pile up — with "Join to Create", going back to the lobby from your own voice channel left that channel empty and never deleted. Nothing could clean it up before a bot restart. Repeated, this filled the lobby's category — and once full, no channel could be created for anyone. Cleanup now happens in every case.
  • 🔒 +bug can no longer reveal what must stay hidden — the report panel shows "your last command" in the channel. It could therefore republish the contents of a report (+report), naming both the person who sent it and their target, as well as deliberately invisible commands. Those contents are no longer stored at all.
  • 🔁 The "Replay" button explains its refusal without cluttering the channel — when you click again too quickly, the wait message is now shown to you alone instead of being posted in the channel. Clicking repeatedly no longer fills the thread with bot messages.
  • ⏰ Reminders stay available to everyone — the number of pending reminders per server is capped, and a handful of people could fill that cap on their own, locking everyone else out of +remind and +announce. A share is now reserved for those with few: a heavy user limits themselves well before inconveniencing anyone.
  • ⚡ Rank display is nearly twice as fast — working out your place in the leaderboard (+level) queried the database in a way that forced it to run two searches and merge them. Rewritten, it runs just one: 1.75× faster, for an identical result. This does not change the bot's overall speed, only that of commands showing a rank.
  • 🎨 Two commands replied without formatting — +base and +warhammer returned some refusals as bare text, while the rest of the bot wraps them in a coloured panel. +warhammer even showed the same message both ways depending on the path taken. This is now consistent.

Les défenses ne se désarment plus par le panneau, et le journal garde ses preuves 🛡️Defenses can no longer be disarmed from the panel, and the log keeps its evidence 🛡️7 août 2026 à 03:50

  • 🛡️ Les seuils anti-nuke et anti-raid sont réservés au propriétaire du serveur — depuis le panneau ⚙️ Configuration, un membre disposant seulement de « Gérer le serveur » pouvait porter le seuil anti-nuke à 999 : le module restait affiché comme actif partout, mais ne se déclenchait plus jamais. Il pouvait aussi couper la journalisation des bans, des rôles et des changements de configuration, rendant la manœuvre invisible. Ces réglages exigent désormais d'être propriétaire du serveur — comme les 33 autres actions de sécurité du panneau. Tout le reste de la configuration reste accessible comme avant.
  • 🔨 Le journal ne perd plus ses preuves de modération — l'archive qui conserve les bannissements, expulsions et retraits de rôles au-delà d'un redémarrage pouvait être effacée par un simple flux bavard : un membre modifiant son message en boucle suffisait à la faire sauter, sans un mot. Elle est maintenant la dernière servie, jamais supprimée, et c'est le flux qui déborde qui est rogné en premier.
  • 🔒 Vos autres serveurs ne s'affichent plus dans un salon — +alertconfig publiait la liste nominative des serveurs que vous possédez, et le message était réécrit avec la liste de la personne suivante qui cliquait dessus. Le panneau public ne montre plus que le réglage du serveur ; vos réglages personnels s'ouvrent en privé via un bouton. +bot ne nomme plus non plus les autres serveurs : il indique simplement le rang du vôtre.
  • 🎮 Trois abus de jeu corrigés — le bouton 🔁 Rejouer relançait une partie sans aucune limite de cadence, ce qui ouvrait un robinet d'XP sur les jeux sans temps d'attente propre ; deux +enquete lancés dans la même seconde faisaient tourner deux enquêtes en parallèle et versaient les récompenses deux fois ; et +roue annonçait un 🛡️ bouclier de série qu'il effaçait aussitôt. Les trois sont réparés.
  • 💬 Le bot ne s'auto-amplifie plus — mentionner vingt membres absents déclenchait vingt réponses du bot. Il n'en envoie plus qu'une, regroupée, et limite la cadence par auteur. Dans le même esprit, +remind est plafonné (25 rappels en attente par personne) : il était possible d'en empiler des milliers et de ralentir le bot pour tous les serveurs.
  • 👍 Les votes des suggestions survivent à un redémarrage — ils n'étaient gardés qu'en mémoire : au premier clic après un redémarrage, un « 👍 12 · 👎 3 » repassait à « 👍 1 · 👎 0 ». Ils sont désormais enregistrés. Et +bug ne peut plus republier, dans un salon, une commande tapée sur un autre serveur.
  • 🛡️ Anti-nuke and anti-raid thresholds are now owner-only — from the ⚙️ Configuration panel, a member with only "Manage Server" could raise the anti-nuke threshold to 999: the module still showed as active everywhere, but would never trigger again. They could also switch off logging for bans, roles and configuration changes, making the whole thing invisible. These settings now require server ownership — like the 33 other security actions in the panel. The rest of the configuration stays as accessible as before.
  • 🔨 The log no longer loses its moderation evidence — the archive that keeps bans, kicks and role removals across a restart could be wiped by a merely chatty stream: one member editing their message in a loop was enough to drop it, silently. It is now the last thing evicted, never deleted, and the overflowing stream is trimmed first.
  • 🔒 Your other servers no longer show up in a channel — +alertconfig published the names of the servers you own, and the message was rewritten with the list of whoever clicked it next. The public panel now shows only the server's own setting; your personal settings open privately via a button. +bot no longer names other servers either — it just gives yours a rank.
  • 🎮 Three game exploits fixed — the 🔁 Replay button re-ran a game with no rate limit at all, which opened an XP tap on games without their own cooldown; two +enquete launched in the same second ran two investigations in parallel and paid rewards twice; and +roue announced a 🛡️ streak shield that it immediately erased. All three are fixed.
  • 💬 The bot no longer amplifies itself — mentioning twenty AFK members triggered twenty bot replies. It now sends a single grouped reply and rate-limits per author. In the same spirit, +remind is capped (25 pending reminders per person): thousands could be stacked, slowing the bot down for every server.
  • 👍 Suggestion votes survive a restart — they were kept in memory only: on the first click after a restart, a "👍 12 · 👎 3" dropped back to "👍 1 · 👎 0". They are now stored. And +bug can no longer republish, in a channel, a command typed on another server.

  • 🔁 Un panneau d'une version antérieure te répond au lieu de ne rien faire — quand le bot était mis à jour, les boutons des panneaux +setup déjà affichés dans un salon pouvaient ne plus rien déclencher : Discord affichait « L'interaction a échoué » sans expliquer pourquoi. Ces boutons t'indiquent maintenant que le panneau date d'une version précédente et qu'il faut relancer +setup. Même correction sur les boutons de +tierlist.

Les caisses redeviennent une surprise, et le journal de modération ne perd plus rien 📦Crates become a surprise again, and the moderation log stops losing entries 📦7 août 2026 à 00:31

  • 📦 Les caisses d'XP tombent à un moment imprévisible — l'écart entre deux caisses était de trente minutes pile : sur un salon actif, il suffisait de compter les minutes pour les attendre. L'écart est maintenant tiré au sort entre quinze et quarante-cinq minutes. Le nombre de caisses par jour ne change pas — c'est la régularité qui disparaît, pour que camper ne rapporte plus rien de plus que participer.
  • 🔨 Le journal de modération ne s'écrase plus lui-même — quand deux actions se suivaient à moins de trente minutes, la seconde remplaçait la première dans le salon de logs : un bannissement suivi d'une expulsion ne laissait que l'expulsion. Chaque action de modération est désormais un message distinct, définitif. Les commandes anodines, elles, restent regroupées pour ne pas noyer le salon.
  • 🔐 « Gérer le serveur » ne donne plus accès aux commandes de crise — cette permission ouvrait par erreur +lockdown, +punish et +backup. Il faut de nouveau être administrateur, ou disposer du palier correspondant. Les panneaux de configuration, eux, restent accessibles comme avant.
  • 📦 XP crates now drop at an unpredictable time — the gap between two crates was exactly thirty minutes: on a busy channel, you only had to count the minutes to wait for them. The gap is now drawn at random between fifteen and forty-five minutes. The number of crates per day is unchanged — what disappears is the regularity, so that camping no longer pays more than taking part.
  • 🔨 The moderation log no longer overwrites itself — when two actions happened less than thirty minutes apart, the second replaced the first in the log channel: a ban followed by a kick left only the kick. Every moderation action is now its own message, kept for good. Ordinary commands stay grouped so the channel isn't flooded.
  • 🔐 « Manage Server » no longer unlocks crisis commands — that permission mistakenly opened +lockdown, +punish and +backup. Administrator, or the matching permission tier, is required again. Configuration panels remain accessible as before.

  • 🌙 Bilan de la journée dans le salon de logs — chaque nuit, le bot publie le bilan de la journée écoulée : combien d'arrivées et de départs, combien de sanctions, de rôles sensibles accordés, de quarantaines, et à quel moment l'activité a été la plus forte. Le journal devient consultable, et les annonces ne partent plus toutes seules 📋The log becomes searchable, and announcements no longer fire on their own 📋6 août 2026 à 16:57

  • 🔎 Nouvelle commande +logs — cherche dans le journal de la journée par membre, par type d'événement ou par plage horaire (+logs @membre, +logs rôles, +logs 14h-16h). La réponse arrive en privé : un journal de modération n'a pas à s'afficher pour tout le salon. Réservée à l'équipe.
  • 📰 Résumé quotidien du journal — un point une fois par jour (« 47 événements cette nuit : 3 arrivées, 2 rôles sensibles, 1 quarantaine ») avec un accès direct au détail. Il faut l'activer soi-même via +digest journal, il se coupe de la même façon, et il ne s'envoie jamais s'il ne s'est rien passé.
  • 🗑️ « Message supprimé » retrouve son contenu — le journal affichait « Auteur : Inconnu » et aucun texte dès que le message dépassait un quart d'heure. Le contenu et l'auteur sont désormais conservés, comme pour les messages modifiés.
  • 🔊 Le compteur « En vocal » se met à jour en direct — il ne se rafraîchissait qu'une fois toutes les 10 minutes et restait figé sur l'ancien nombre. Il réagit maintenant aux entrées et sorties en quasi temps réel, sans jamais dépasser la limite de renommage imposée par Discord.
  • 🚨 Quarantaine : une relance qui vise quelqu'un d'autre — si un dossier reste sans décision, un second rappel part vers un propriétaire différent du premier destinataire ; rappeler une personne absente ne sert à rien. Une seule escalade, et toujours aucune libération automatique : personne ne ressort de quarantaine sans qu'un humain l'ait décidé.
  • 📬 Le rapport de publication ne cache plus rien — il annonçait « 4 propriétaires » sans dire si le message avait été reçu, refusé ou volontairement sauté. Il distingue maintenant délivrés, désinscrits et échecs, avec la cause. Quelqu'un qui s'est désinscrit par erreur peut enfin s'en apercevoir.
  • 🔒 Une annonce ne part plus toute seule — une nouvelle commande pouvait être annoncée à tous les serveurs quelques minutes après avoir été écrite, avant même d'être traduite. Une annonce est désormais reportée tant que la commande n'est pas complète, et une mise à jour peut être retenue jusqu'à validation.
  • 🔐 Le site ne publie plus ses points faibles — le panneau public affichait combien de cas la détection avait manqués. Cette information reste visible pour les propriétaires, mais elle n'a rien à faire sur une page publique. La précision globale, elle, reste affichée.
  • 🧹 Un processus fantôme en moins — la surveillance des autres bots laissait derrière elle un processus bloqué à chaque passage, qui s'accumulait silencieusement sur la machine.
  • 🔎 New +logs command — search the day's log by member, event type or time range (+logs @member, +logs roles, +logs 14h-16h). The answer arrives privately: a moderation log has no business being displayed to the whole channel. Staff only.
  • 📰 Daily log summary — one round-up per day ("47 events last night: 3 joins, 2 sensitive roles, 1 quarantine") with direct access to the detail. You enable it yourself via +digest journal, turn it off the same way, and it is never sent when nothing happened.
  • 🗑️ « Message deleted » gets its content back — the log showed « Author: Unknown » and no text as soon as the message was over fifteen minutes old. Content and author are now kept, just like for edited messages.
  • 🔊 The « In voice » counter updates live — it only refreshed once every 10 minutes and stayed stuck on the old number. It now reacts to people joining and leaving in near real time, without ever exceeding Discord's channel-rename limit.
  • 🚨 Quarantine: a follow-up aimed at someone else — if a case is left undecided, a second reminder goes to a different owner than the first; reminding an absent person achieves nothing. One escalation only, and still no automatic release: nobody leaves quarantine without a human deciding.
  • 📬 The publication report no longer hides anything — it reported « 4 owners » without saying whether the message was received, refused or deliberately skipped. It now separates delivered, unsubscribed and failed, with the reason. Someone who unsubscribed by mistake can finally notice.
  • 🔒 An announcement no longer fires on its own — a new command could be announced to every server minutes after being written, before it was even translated. An announcement is now postponed while the command is incomplete, and an update can be held back until approved.
  • 🔐 The site no longer publishes its weak spots — the public panel showed how many cases detection had missed. That stays visible to owners, but it has no place on a public page. Overall accuracy is still shown.
  • 🧹 One ghost process fewer — the watchdog over the other bots left a stuck process behind on every run, quietly piling up on the machine.

Protections réparées en profondeur, logs qui ne perdent plus rien 🛡️Protections repaired in depth, logs that lose nothing 🛡️6 août 2026 à 15:03

  • 🔒 Désactiver une protection critique exige de nouveau une double validation — sur un module encore jamais configuré, la demande partait immédiatement, sans qu'un second propriétaire ait à confirmer. La garde s'applique désormais quel que soit l'état du module.
  • 🛡️ La quarantaine s'affiche enfin comme ce qu'elle est — sur les serveurs qui ne l'avaient jamais activée à la main, l'interface annonçait « 🔴 Désactivé » pour une protection qui les protégeait bel et bien. Les compteurs de +antiraid, +bot, +base et de l'assistant disent maintenant la vérité.
  • 🔓 Sortie de quarantaine : les rôles sont rendus — les rôles retirés à la mise en quarantaine sont mémorisés puis restaurés au clic sur « Libérer ». Avant, un faux positif coûtait ses rôles définitivement. La zone de quarantaine isole aussi réellement, et la voie de recours du membre survit à un redémarrage.
  • 📋 Le journal ne perd plus rien — le récapitulatif archive désormais toute la journée au lieu des 25 dernières entrées : cliquer sur un message affiché ce matin fonctionne encore ce soir, y compris après un redémarrage. Le menu reste à 25 entrées (limite de Discord), mais plus rien n'est jeté.
  • ✏️ « Message modifié » affiche à nouveau l'avant — le contenu précédent était perdu dès que le message dépassait un quart d'heure, c'est-à-dire l'information même pour laquelle ce log existe. Il est maintenant conservé.
  • 🚨 La quarantaine ne peut plus échouer en silence — quand la zone d'isolement est indisponible ou que le message privé à la personne concernée n'arrive pas, c'est signalé au propriétaire au lieu de laisser croire que tout s'est bien passé. Et un dossier laissé sans décision est relancé une fois.
  • 📬 Une demande de validation ne peut plus rester invisible — si aucun propriétaire ne peut être joint en message privé, la demande est publiée dans le salon de logs, à condition qu'il ne soit pas visible de tous. La règle ne change pas : il faut toujours un autre propriétaire pour confirmer.
  • 🔐 Moins d'informations exploitables publiées — le panneau public du site détaillait les cas d'entraînement de l'IA de sécurité, et certaines commandes affichaient des scores individuels dans le salon où elles étaient tapées. Tout cela reste accessible aux propriétaires, mais n'est plus exposé : c'est la diffusion qui change, pas le contenu.
  • 📊 Panneau de sécurité : plus de doublons — reposter le panneau dans un salon qui en avait déjà un les empilait, et chacun se réactualisait en parallèle. Un seul panneau vivant par salon, et +base prévient désormais quand le salon choisi est visible de tous.
  • 🧹 Les données d'un serveur restent chez lui — +importconfig recopiait vers le serveur cible des extraits de journaux (pseudos, messages supprimés, noms de modérateurs) et des menus de rôles dont les identifiants n'y avaient aucun sens. Ces données sont désormais exclues des copies et des sauvegardes.
  • ⚡ Quelques crashs de moins — +base pouvait mourir sans réponse sur une configuration abîmée par un import ou une restauration ; le journal des changements de sécurité écrasait parfois le précédent au lieu de s'y ajouter.
  • 🧪 Trois contrôles de plus avant chaque mise à jour — la publication du site est vérifiée automatiquement, et deux contrôles qui pouvaient passer au vert alors que le programme avait planté exigent maintenant une preuve qu'ils sont allés au bout. Le bot compte 340 tests automatiques, contre 202 il y a deux jours.
  • 🔒 Disabling a critical protection requires two approvals again — on a module that had never been configured, the request went through immediately, without a second owner confirming. The guard now applies whatever the module's state.
  • 🛡️ Quarantine finally shows up for what it is — on servers that had never enabled it by hand, the interface reported « 🔴 Disabled » for a protection that was in fact running. The counters in +antiraid, +bot, +base and the assistant now tell the truth.
  • 🔓 Leaving quarantine: roles are given back — roles removed on quarantine are recorded and restored when you click « Release ». Before, a false positive cost them for good. The quarantine area now genuinely isolates, and the member's appeal route survives a restart.
  • 📋 The log no longer loses anything — the summary now archives the whole day instead of the last 25 entries: clicking a message posted this morning still works tonight, restart included. The dropdown still holds 25 entries (a Discord limit), but nothing is discarded any more.
  • ✏️ « Message edited » shows the before again — the previous content was lost as soon as the message was over fifteen minutes old, which is precisely the information this log exists for. It is now kept.
  • 🚨 Quarantine can no longer fail silently — when the isolation area is unavailable or the private message to the person doesn't arrive, the owner is told instead of being left to assume all went well. And a case left undecided is followed up once.
  • 📬 A validation request can no longer stay invisible — if no owner can be reached by DM, the request is posted in the log channel, provided it isn't visible to everyone. The rule is unchanged: another owner must still confirm.
  • 🔐 Less exploitable information published — the site's public panel detailed the security AI's training cases, and some commands showed individual scores in the channel where they were typed. All of it remains available to owners, but is no longer exposed: what changed is the audience, not the content.
  • 📊 Security panel: no more duplicates — re-posting the panel in a channel that already had one stacked them, each refreshing in parallel. One live panel per channel now, and +base warns when the chosen channel is visible to everyone.
  • 🧹 A server's data stays with that server — +importconfig copied log excerpts (nicknames, deleted messages, moderator names) and role menus whose IDs meant nothing on the target. That data is now excluded from copies and backups.
  • ⚡ A few crashes fewer — +base could die without answering on a config damaged by an import or a restore; the security-change log sometimes overwrote the previous one instead of adding to it.
  • 🧪 Three more checks before each update — the site's published data is now verified automatically, and two checks that could pass while the program had actually crashed now require proof they ran to completion. The bot has 340 automated tests, up from 202 two days ago.

  • 📬 Fini les MP en rafale — désactiver plusieurs protections d'un coup envoyait autant de demandes de validation que de modules. Elles sont maintenant regroupées en une seule, sans rien changer à la règle : il faut toujours un autre owner pour confirmer.
  • 🩹 Corrections de plantages — plusieurs commandes ne répondaient plus du tout quand on leur donnait un argument très long ; +gala pouvait rester cassé durablement ; les messages de bienvenue et d'adieu n'étaient plus envoyés si le texte personnalisé était trop long ; un double-clic sur « Ouvrir un ticket » créait deux salons.
  • 🔎 Nouvel outil interne — un harnais exécute chaque commande contre un vrai serveur avec des arguments limites (vide, absurde, énorme, cible inexistante) : c'est lui qui a révélé la plupart des corrections ci-dessus.
  • 🛡️ Quarantine: core protection, always on — it automatically isolates an account that just did something serious, until an owner decides. It is now enabled by default on every server (previously only if you turned it on yourself) and can no longer be disabled, through any path. Progressive trust follows the same rule.
  • 💬 Every bot message is now an embed — 92 commands still replied in plain text ("Usage: …") inside a bot that uses embeds everywhere else. Every error, refusal and usage note is now presented properly, with a concrete example and your server's real prefix (help could previously show +command on a server using !).
  • 📋 Logs grouped into a single message — instead of stacking one message per event, a single summary updates itself, showing the time, what happened and who did it. A dropdown opens the full detail of each entry, as a private reply — and that detail stays available even after the bot restarts. Security logs (ban, kick, timeout, channel deletion) stay separate messages: grouping them would erase the evidence of an incident.
  • 🎭 +rolemenu is now a full editor — buttons or dropdown, multiple / exclusive (one role at a time: colours, pronouns, teams) / locked (take but never remove) modes, minimum-maximum limits, emoji + label + description + colour per entry, access restricted by role or account age, editing an existing menu without recreating it, duplication and deletion.

  • 🎮 Around sixty fixes across the games — tic-tac-toe no longer slows the bot down (the AI was computing up to 550,000 possibilities per move), the +devine podium finally shows up with many players, +casino no longer charges a bet without showing the round, the +defi panel is playable by everyone again, +motus no longer displays an empty cell, and games no longer get stuck on "a game is already running".
  • ⚙️ Simpler +setup menu — the three "Logs" entries (channel, event types, changelog channel) are merged into one, with exactly the same settings. The step-by-step assistant now offers a multiple choice at each step instead of all-or-nothing, and optional features (security report by DM, off-server backup) can be turned off from the same screen.
  • 📊 Live security panel — the assistant can post it in the channel of your choice; it refreshes on its own. Fixed: re-selecting a channel that already had one no longer does nothing, and several panels can no longer pile up in the same channel.
  • 🎮 Restricted games channel — the games channel can be visible only to holders of the 🎮 Player role, granted automatically on the first game command, from any channel (no dead end for newcomers).
  • 📬 No more DM bursts — disabling several protections at once used to send one validation request per module. They are now grouped into a single one, with no change to the rule: another owner is still required to confirm.
  • 🩹 Crash fixes — several commands stopped replying entirely when given a very long argument; +gala could stay broken for good; welcome and goodbye messages were no longer sent when the custom text was too long; double-clicking "Open a ticket" created two channels.
  • 🔎 New internal tooling — a harness now runs every command against a real Discord server with edge-case arguments (empty, absurd, huge, non-existent target): it is what surfaced most of the fixes above.

  • 👋 Accueil rattrapé : si le bot est ajouté à un serveur pendant qu'il est hors ligne, il envoie l'accueil au propriétaire à son retour (avant, l'accueil était simplement perdu).
  • 🎮 Jeux : +heist, +jeux, +ftg et la récompense quotidienne sont enfin accessibles à tous (ils étaient réservés aux admins par erreur) · les jeux versent aussi de l'aura en plus de l'XP · +snipe et le solde du casino corrigés · alias +lvl pour +level.

  • 🧪 +testalerts restricted to the root owner only (instead of any bot owner) — consistent with other sensitive diagnostic commands.

Values are now validated before being stored: no more fake protection. Do re-check your modules with +antiraid.
  • 🧹 Ghost gifts cleaned up: after a bot restart, leftover crates 📦 and surprise events showed “the application did not respond” when clicked. They are now detected and removed automatically. Live gifts, however, never expire — they stay available until claimed.

  • 🔔 More readable logs: no more log entry on every button click — only security actions are recorded. Moderation logs no longer overwrite each other (a ban could vanish on the next unban), the author of a role change is properly identified, and an alert now flags buttons that stop responding.
  • 👋 Catch-up welcome: if the bot is added to a server while offline, it sends the welcome to the owner once it's back (previously the welcome was simply lost).
  • 🎮 Games: +heist, +jeux, +ftg and the daily reward are finally available to everyone (they were admin-only by mistake) · games now also pay aura on top of XP · +snipe and the casino balance fixed · +lvl alias for +level.

  • 🗿 +mog retrouve ses GIFs (et gagne des rebondissements) : les GIFs s'affichent de nouveau — pool stable d'images vérifiées (l'ancienne source ne renvoyait plus rien) — et le mog peut désormais mal tourner : contre-mog 🔄 (la cible retourne la situation), double KO 🤝, mog critique ×2 💥, sans oublier l'auto-mog si tu te mentionnes toi-même 🪞.
  • 🕵️ +quidit choisit de meilleures citations : fini les messages vides (images/pièces jointes sans texte), épinglés, commandes, liens ou mots isolés — le jeu privilégie maintenant les vraies phrases fun et farfelues, avec un petit bonus pour les pépites oubliées (les vieux messages drôles ressortent un peu plus souvent).
  • ⭕❌ Le morpion contre le bot est plus malin ET plus juste : l'IA ne rate plus jamais une victoire ou un blocage évident (défense parfaite), mais relâche volontairement un coup stratégique sur quatre — un bon joueur peut la battre à la fourchette, un débutant ne la trouvera plus « bête » ni imbattable.
  • 📰 Nouvelle commande +news : les dernières nouveautés ✨ et suppressions 🗑️ du bot, groupées par date dans un embed compact — le mini-changelog directement en jeu, sans quitter Discord (alias +quoideneuf).
  • 🔔 Rôle d'alerte plus clair dans +setup : l'écran du rôle d'alerte sécurité affiche maintenant le nom du rôle configuré (ou « aucun », y compris si le rôle a été supprimé entre-temps), le présélectionne dans le menu, et une sélection vide permet de le retirer d'un clic.
  • 🎖️ Des grades universels : l'échelle de progression abandonne son thème guerrier pour des noms parlants à tous — Aspirant → Aventurier → Explorateur → Vétéran → Élite → Champion → Héros → Maître → Légende. Les rôles existants sont renommés automatiquement (+grade sync), tes niveaux et paliers ne bougent pas.
  • 🎁 Caisses surprises & casino au ton neutre : la caisse gagnée annonce sobrement « 🎁 Récompense ! @toi gagnes +XP », les énigmes des caisses verrouillées passent en culture générale, et le casino, la roulette et le blackjack perdent leur habillage « impérial » — mêmes jeux, mêmes gains.
  • 🤫 Nouvelle commande +ftg : dis (gentiment) à quelqu'un de fermer sa gueule — pur banter façon +mog, avec GIF « shut up » et une réaction ➕ posée par le bot pour que le salon vote le ftg. Mention cliquable mais sans ping, petit cooldown anti-spam (alias +tg, +chut).
  • 🏠 Bouton « Menu » dans +setup : les pages profondes du menu (éditeur de commandes perso, réaction-rôles, historique Guardian, signalements du réseau…) gagnent un bouton 🏠 Menu à côté de « Retour » — retour au menu principal en un clic au lieu de remonter cran par cran.
  • 🎰 The casino no longer floods the channel: slots, roulette and blackjack now live in a single self-updating message — the 🔁 Replay button reruns a round in place (same stake, same bet), and blackjack deals a fresh hand at the same table. Same rules, same safeguards (anti-double-table lock, cooldown, balance checked every round).
  • 🏇 The race becomes a proper horse Grand Prix: the 40k factions make way for 15 legendary racehorses (Secretariat, Seabiscuit, Frankel, Winx, Phar Lap, Red Rum…) — 5 starters drawn per race, each under its coloured silks, with mood GIFs at the betting lobby and the photo finish. Odds, bets and flow unchanged.
  • 🌱 +trust finally explained: the progressive-trust description now says what it does — newcomers earn their stripes (a few days around, or some participation) before posting links or mass-mentioning, limits lift on their own, no punishment. Built against throwaway accounts and link spammers, invisible to your real members.
  • 🗿 +mog gets its GIFs back (and new twists): GIFs display again — a stable pool of verified images (the old source had gone silent) — and a mog can now backfire: counter-mog 🔄 (the target turns it around), double KO 🤝, critical ×2 mog 💥, plus a special self-mog if you mention yourself 🪞.
  • 🕵️ +quidit picks better quotes: no more empty messages (image/attachment-only), pinned, commands, links or single words — the game now favours real fun and quirky sentences, with a small bonus for forgotten gems (old funny messages come up a bit more often).
  • ⭕❌ Tic-tac-toe vs the bot is smarter AND fairer: the AI never misses an obvious win or block anymore (perfect defense), but deliberately relaxes one strategic move in four — a good player can beat it with a fork, a beginner won't find it « dumb » or unbeatable.
  • 📰 New +news command: the bot's latest additions ✨ and removals 🗑️, grouped by date in a compact embed — the mini-changelog right inside Discord (alias +whatsnew).
  • 🔔 Clearer alert role in +setup: the security alert-role screen now shows the configured role's name (or « none », including when the role was deleted in the meantime), preselects it in the menu, and an empty selection removes it in one click.
  • 🎖️ Universal ranks: the progression ladder drops its war theme for names everyone gets — Aspirant → Adventurer → Explorer → Veteran → Elite → Champion → Hero → Master → Legend. Existing roles are renamed automatically (+grade sync), your levels and thresholds stay untouched.
  • 🎁 Surprise crates & casino in a neutral tone: a claimed crate now simply announces "🎁 Reward! @you gain +XP", locked-crate riddles switch to general knowledge, and the casino, roulette and blackjack lose their "imperial" dressing — same games, same payouts.
  • 🤫 New +ftg command: (gently) tell someone to shut it — pure +mog-style banter, with a "shut up" GIF and a ➕ reaction added by the bot so the channel can vote on the ftg. Clickable mention but no ping, light anti-spam cooldown (aliases +tg, +chut).
  • 🏠 "Menu" button in +setup: deep pages of the menu (custom-command editor, reaction roles, Guardian history, network reports…) get a 🏠 Menu button next to "Back" — jump straight to the main menu instead of climbing one level at a time.

Nouveaux jeux & bouclier anti-vanity 🎮🛡️New games & anti-vanity shield 🎮🛡️5 juillet 2026 à 19:50

  • 🛡️ Grande passe de fiabilité & sécurité : audit complet du code (chaque fichier relu) et ~35 correctifs déployés — sanctions de modération plus fiables (retour clair en cas d'échec ; +purge/+clear respectent enfin le nombre demandé), jeux sans double-comptage ni blocage (morpion, bang, aura, blackjack…), anti-raid plus juste (un départ volontaire n'est plus confondu avec une expulsion → plus de fausse alerte contre un modo), attribution des invitations corrigée, montées de niveau instantanées sur les grosses récompenses, et Guardian AI durci. Et quand VirusTotal ne peut pas vérifier un fichier (archive ou document à macros pendant un pic de charge), un avertissement « ⚠️ non vérifiable — prudence » s'affiche désormais au lieu d'un simple « analyse différée ».
  • 🔗 Nouveau bouclier : protection de l'URL vanity (discord.gg/ton-serveur). Active-le avec +antiraid antivanity on (ou tout d'un coup via +harden) : si quelqu'un change l'URL vanity de ton serveur, le bot la restaure automatiquement en un instant, retire les rôles sensibles de l'auteur et t'alerte. Ta vanity — et tous les liens d'invitation qui en dépendent — ne peuvent plus t'être volés.
  • 🎮 4 nouveaux jeux : 🟩 +motus le mot du jour façon Wordle (mot commun à tout le serveur, 6 essais, série de jours, partage sans spoiler) · 🎡 +roue un spin GRATUIT par jour (aura, XP ou JACKPOT, ta série booste les gains) · ⚓ +navale la bataille navale 1v1 par boutons (touché = tu rejoues) · ⌨️ +typerace la course de frappe (le premier à recopier la phrase gagne — le copier-coller ne marche pas 😏).
  • ✨ Confort de jeu : ⚓ +navale se joue maintenant en SOLO contre le bot (une IA qui vise juste) — plus besoin d'un adversaire en ligne · 🎮 +jeux devient un menu déroulant pour parcourir tous les jeux par catégorie · 🗿 +mog accepte enfin plusieurs cibles d'un coup (+mog @a @b @c).
  • 🛡️ Major reliability & security pass: a full code audit (every file re-read) shipped ~35 fixes — more reliable moderation actions (clear feedback on failure; +purge/+clear now honor the requested count), games with no more double-counting or freezes (tic-tac-toe, bang, aura, blackjack…), fairer anti-raid (a voluntary leave is no longer mistaken for a kick → no more false alert against a mod), fixed invite attribution, instant level-ups on big rewards, and hardened Guardian AI. Nothing visible day-to-day — just a sturdier bot.
  • 🧪 Tougher attachment scanning: the list of auto-blocked dangerous extensions was widened (Windows scripts, booby-trapped shortcuts, applets…). And when VirusTotal can't verify a file (an archive or macro-doc during a load spike), a « ⚠️ unverifiable — be careful » warning is now shown instead of a plain « analysis deferred ».
  • 🔗 New shield: vanity URL protection (discord.gg/your-server). Turn it on with +antiraid antivanity on (or all at once via +harden): if someone changes your server's vanity URL, the bot instantly restores it, strips the culprit's sensitive roles, and alerts you. Your vanity — and every invite link that relies on it — can no longer be stolen.
  • 🎮 4 new games: 🟩 +motus word of the day, Wordle-style (one word for the whole server, 6 guesses, day streaks, spoiler-free sharing) · 🎡 +roue one FREE daily spin (aura, XP or JACKPOT, your streak boosts winnings) · ⚓ +navale 1v1 Battleship on a button grid (a hit lets you fire again) · ⌨️ +typerace typing race (first to retype the sentence wins — copy-paste won't work 😏).
  • ✨ Game quality-of-life: ⚓ +navale can now be played SOLO vs the bot (a sharp-shooting AI) — no online opponent needed · 🎮 +jeux is now a dropdown menu to browse every game by category · 🗿 +mog finally takes several targets at once (+mog @a @b @c).

Sécurité renforcée 🛡️ : anti-phishing, +firedrill, +report & confirmation 2 owners — classements en imageHardened security 🛡️: anti-phishing, +firedrill, +report & two-owner confirmation — image leaderboards29 juin 2026 à 09:21

  • 🔧 Correctif +bang : la règle des vies est désormais claire et appliquée ainsi — une partie à exactement 2 joueurs se joue à 3 vies chacun, et une partie à 3 joueurs ou plus à 1 vie chacun (élimination directe, dernier debout gagne). Les vies sont fixées à la composition de la partie : plus de bascule « 3 vies » en cours de jeu.
  • 🔐 Confirmation à 2 owners pour rendre un accès sensible : autoriser un derank Guardian, lever une quarantaine, retirer une blacklist (+unbl) et ajouter un owner (+owner add) exigent maintenant 2 owners distincts — un owner compromis seul ne peut plus rien rendre. Les boutons Autoriser/Refuser des alertes Guardian fonctionnent désormais même après un redémarrage, la fenêtre de décision passe à 15 min, et un owner ne reçoit jamais l'alerte qui le concerne lui-même. S'il n'y a qu'un seul owner sur le serveur (impossible d'en réunir 2), l'autorisation passe mais déclenche une 🚨 vigilance : les autres owners du bot sont prévenus (même sur d'autres serveurs) et la surveillance du serveur est renforcée — un owner unique piraté ne peut donc plus agir dans l'ombre.
  • 👁️ Surveillance des comptes de confiance : les owners et membres whitelistés restent surveillés (sans sanction auto) — alerte si l'un d'eux donne des permissions à un compte suspect (jugé par l'IA Guardian). De plus, chaque ajout/retrait de whitelist est journalisé avec l'indice de risque et les permissions sensibles du membre.
  • 🕵️ Détection de compte compromis : Guardian apprend le comportement normal de chaque membre établi et alerte si un compte ancien et de confiance se met soudain à agir anormalement (scam/phishing, lien d'invitation alors qu'il n'en poste jamais, mass-mention inhabituelle, activité en pleine nuit…) — le signe classique d'un compte piraté. Alerte seulement (aucune sanction auto sur un membre établi), suppression du message s'il est malveillant, + bouton Mettre en quarantaine pour le staff. Comble l'angle mort des protections centrées sur les nouveaux comptes.
  • 📒 +history enrichi : en plus des sanctions du bot, il retrouve les bans/expulsions dans les logs d'audit Discord (faites à la main ou hors bot) et les mémorise au casier — un historique unifié qui se complète tout seul.
  • 📊 +level enrichi : voit désormais l'XP gagnée à l'écrit vs en vocal séparément, le temps passé en vocal, et un bouton Classement intégré.
  • 🎲 +devine : le « plus haut / plus bas » revient en message (au lieu d'une réaction) — plus lisible, comme avant. De plus, un petit lobby compte les joueurs avant de lancer : ≤ 2 joueurs → nombre entre 1 et 100, 3 joueurs ou plus → entre 1 et 1000. Le podium affiche deux records séparés (un par mode, 1–100 et 1–1000), signalés quand ils sont battus 🏆.

  • 🔧 Salon d'erreurs plus précis (owner) : les erreurs d'API Discord (« Invalid Form Body »…) affichent maintenant le champ exact en cause — on corrige d'un coup d'œil au lieu de chercher à l'aveugle.
  • 🎣 Anti-phishing renforcé : le bot bloque désormais les liens de scam/arnaque connus grâce à une blocklist communautaire d'environ 37 000 domaines malveillants (faux Nitro, vol de token/compte), mise à jour automatiquement (toutes les 12 h) et conservée même hors ligne — en plus de la détection des faux domaines par ressemblance.   • 🪖 Nouvelle commande +firedrill (exercice d'attaque à blanc) : simule un raid puis un nuke et te montre exactement ce qui se passerait selon ta config (seuils, lockdown, derank, restauration), avec un score de préparation et la liste des failles à corriger — sans aucune action réelle. Pour vérifier tes défenses avant la vraie attaque.
  • ⚡ Classements quasi instantanés : un cache d'avatars (10 min) évite de re-télécharger les mêmes images → cartes +leaderboard / +gameleaderboard / +level bien plus rapides et quasi plus de timeouts CDN.
  • 🌐 Alertes de sécurité plus fiables : en cas de micro-coupure réseau (blip transitoire), les alertes owner, les alertes antiraid, les notifications de changement de sécurité et les signalements +report envoyés au staff réessaient automatiquement au lieu d'être perdus — une alerte critique ne saute plus pour un simple hoquet de connexion.
  • 💬 +dm plus robuste : le message est désormais plafonné à la limite Discord (4096 caractères) → plus d'échec avec un message d'erreur trompeur quand le texte est très long.
  • 🛡️ Attributions de rôle automatiques sécurisées (anti-escalade) : impossible d'attribuer automatiquement un rôle à permissions sensibles (Administrateur, gérer rôles/salons, ban…) via les voies auto / self-service — auto-rôle d'arrivée, rôle de vérification (bouton « Vérifier »), récompenses de niveau, rôle d'anniversaire et rôle « Chasseur de bug » (+bug). Si le rôle devient dangereux après coup — ou qu'un rôle homonyme piégé est créé — l'attribution est bloquée (et les owners prévenus pour l'auto-rôle/vérification) → un admin ne peut plus (par erreur ou malveillance) donner ces droits à chaque membre.
  • 🔒 Quarantaine plus honnête : si un rôle à permissions sensibles est positionné au-dessus du rôle du bot, le bot ne peut pas le retirer — la quarantaine signale désormais clairement qu'elle est INCOMPLÈTE (rôle(s) non retiré(s), donc membre encore dangereux) et prévient les owners de monter le rôle du bot, au lieu d'annoncer à tort « tous les rôles retirés ».
  • 🎉 Giveaways plus justes : au tirage, le gagnant est choisi uniquement parmi les participants encore présents sur le serveur et qui ont toujours le rôle requis — un membre qui a quitté, perdu le rôle requis ou été mis en quarantaine après s'être inscrit ne peut plus rafler le prix.
  • 🔊 Salons vocaux temporaires : plus de fuite : les salons « Join-to-Create » sont désormais mémorisés (persistés) — après un redémarrage du bot, les salons temporaires vides sont nettoyés et les occupés restent suivis, au lieu de rester orphelins indéfiniment.
  • 💾 Restauration de serveur plus robuste : un backup légèrement corrompu ne fait plus échouer toute la reprise — une permission illisible est traitée comme « aucune permission » (fail-safe) et la restauration continue (rôles/salons restants recréés) au lieu de s'arrêter net.
  • 🩺 Surveillance santé renforcée + auto-réparation (owner) : +diag ajoute la latence de la base, l'espace disque libre et la détection d'une 2ᵉ instance du bot (cause du bug « messageCreate muet »). Et si le site de doc reste injoignable plusieurs contrôles d'affilée, le bot re-déploie tout seul la dernière version puis te prévient.
  • 🎉 Carte de bienvenue en image : à l'arrivée d'un nouveau membre, le bot poste un joli bandeau (avatar, « Bienvenue sur {serveur} », pseudo, Nᵉ membre) — avec ta bannière de serveur en fond si tu en as une. Repli automatique sur le message classique.
  • 🧹 Robustesse mémoire : audit de tout le code — l'anti-usurpation d'identité plafonne désormais ses listes anti-spam internes (comme le reste du bot), supprimant la dernière source de croissance mémoire lente sur très longue durée. (Sécurité revérifiée : aucune faille, 0 vulnérabilité.)
  • 🧠 Apprentissage autonome plus régulier : le cycle d'entraînement de l'IA Guardian reprend son rythme après un redémarrage (au lieu de relancer un compte à rebours complet) — fini le panneau du site qui semble « bloqué » sur le même cycle quand le bot a redémarré récemment ; les mises à jour reviennent de façon fiable toutes les ~25 min.
  • 👋 Carte d'au revoir en image + +rank : quand un membre part, le bot poste un bandeau d'au revoir assorti à la carte de bienvenue (avatar + bannière du serveur). Les cartes bienvenue/au revoir sont testables (aperçu) et désactivables depuis +setup → 👋 Bienvenue & Au revoir. Et +level répond aussi à +rank / +rang.
  • 🐲 Mascotte du serveur améliorée (+pet) : elle alerte maintenant la communauté quand elle a faim, tombe malade, s'enfuit ou se rétablit (dans un salon configurable via +pet channel) — fini de la laisser dépérir en silence pendant que le serveur dort. Nouveau +pet play pour jouer avec elle (booste son bonheur), et affichage enrichi : compte à rebours d'évolution + record de longévité du serveur.
  • 🚫 Blacklist rank plus fiable : quand un membre blacklisté (sur ce serveur) reçoit un rôle, le bot le retire en bloc et sanctionne celui qui l'a donné — il ignore désormais les rôles non retirables (booster/intégration) et n'indique « sanctionné » que si l'auteur l'a réellement été (sinon il te demande d'intervenir à la main).
  • 🔌 Antideco ajusté : la protection anti-déconnexions vocales abusives passe par défaut à 5 déconnexions / 10 min (au lieu de 3 / 10 s) — elle attrape désormais aussi le harcèlement répétitif (déconnecter quelqu'un encore et encore), pas seulement les rafales instantanées. Activable dans +setup → Sécurité.
  • 🛠️ Anti-doublon du changelog : le bot ne renvoie plus jamais deux fois le même point de changelog — même si une version est re-publiée ou que le numéro est bumpé, seules les vraies nouveautés partent en MP et dans les salons (dédup par signature d'item). Fini les annonces en double.
  • 🔧 +bang fix: the lives rule is now clear and works like this — a game with exactly 2 players is played with 3 lives each, and a game with 3+ players with 1 life each (instant elimination, last one standing wins). Lives are set by the game's player count: no more mid-game switch to 3 lives.
  • 🔐 Two-owner confirmation to restore sensitive access: authorizing a Guardian derank, lifting a quarantine, removing a blacklist (+unbl) and adding an owner (+owner add) now require 2 distinct owners — a single compromised owner can no longer restore anything. Guardian alert Authorize/Refuse buttons now work even after a restart, the decision window is now 15 min, and an owner never receives the alert about themselves. If there's only one owner on the server (can't gather 2), the action goes through but triggers a 🚨 vigilance notice: the other bot owners are warned (even on other servers) and the server's monitoring is heightened — so a single hacked owner can no longer act in the shadows.
  • 👁️ Trusted-account monitoring: owners and whitelisted members stay monitored (no auto-sanction) — you're alerted if one of them grants permissions to a suspicious account (judged by the Guardian AI). Plus, every whitelist add/remove is logged with the member's risk index and sensitive permissions.
  • 🕵️ Compromised-account detection: Guardian learns each established member's normal behavior and alerts if an old, trusted account suddenly acts out of character (scam/phishing, an invite link when they never post links, unusual mass-mention, late-night activity…) — the classic sign of a hacked account. Alert-only (no auto-sanction on an established member), deletes the message if it's malicious, + a Quarantine button for staff. Covers the blind spot of protections focused on new accounts.
  • 📒 +history upgraded: on top of the bot's own cases, it pulls bans/kicks from Discord's audit log (done manually or outside the bot) and remembers them — a unified record that fills itself in.
  • 📊 +level upgraded: now shows text vs voice XP separately, time spent in voice, and a built-in Leaderboard button.
  • 🎲 +devine: the higher/lower hint is back as a message (instead of a reaction) — clearer, like before. A quick lobby also counts players before starting: ≤ 2 players → number from 1 to 100, 3+ players → from 1 to 1000, with two separate records (one per mode) shown on the podium and flagged when beaten 🏆.
  • 🎨 Website: redesigned language and theme buttons + subtle animations on all buttons.
  • 🎉 Giveaways with requirements: a +giveaway can now require a role, a level, a server tenure (ancien:7j) and/or a minimum account age (compte:30j) to enter — anti-alt, real members only. E.g. +giveaway 1h 1 Nitro @VIP niveau:5 ancien:7j compte:30j.
  • 🟣 New fun command +aura: give a member (or yourself) MAXIMUM aura — a hype embed 🟣🔥 with a gif. +aura @member · per-server custom GIF via +aura gif <url>.
  • 🔁 Replay button on games: when a game ends (+devine, +quizz, +loto, +sondagefun, +morpion, +rps, +warhammer, +raid), a 🔁 Replay button restarts it in one click — tic-tac-toe even offers a rematch of the same two players.
  • 📚 New +doc command: shows the online documentation link in a clean embed with a direct-access button.
  • 🟢 Dynamic bot status: the activity alternates between “+setup / +menu” and the status follows the time of day — 🟢 online during the day, 🔴 do-not-disturb 6am–10am, 🌙 idle 9pm–6am (never invisible).
  • ↩️ Undo button on sanctions: every ban, tempban, mute (+tempsmute) and warning (+warn) now shows an ↩️ Undo button — staff can fix a misclick or wrong target in one click (unban / unmute / remove the warn).
  • 🖼️ +level as an image: the level card now renders as an image (avatar, level, rank, progress bar, text/voice XP) instead of plain text. If your avatar is animated (GIF), the card animates too 🎞️.
  • 🎯 More detailed command logs: each log clearly shows who ran the command and who is targeted, with both IDs.
  • 🛡️ New +report command: any member can discreetly report someone to staff — +report @member <reason> or by replying to their message. Staff get an alert with the member's security context (account age, local + global danger index, sensitive roles, record) and Quarantine / Ban / Ignore buttons. The command is deleted instantly and the reporter is thanked in DM — nobody sees who reported.
  • 📊 +base in the menu: the live Security board (permanent panel of active protections, self-updating) now opens straight from +setup → 🛡️ Security button → “Live security board”, in addition to the +base command.
  • 🎮 Game leaderboard completed: tic-tac-toe ⭕, +bang 🔫 and +warhammer ⚔️ now count in +gameleaderboard (alongside quizz/loto/devine/poll), with an emoji legend — each player only shows the games they actually won.
  • 🎙️ Voice XP in the leaderboard: +leaderboard now shows each member's voice XP next to their total.
  • 🧪 Clearer +diag full (owner): the full self-check now shows in a readable embed — a clean summary per test (logic, commands, embeds, security) instead of raw console lines, and the embed always replaces the “running…” message.
  • 🔔 More precise health-monitor alert + Fix button (owner): when the hourly monitor finds an issue, the DM now shows, for each critical point, its state, cause and how to fix it (exact command). A 🔧 Fix / Re-check button attempts a safe auto-repair (database journal compaction) then re-runs the diagnostic in one click — perfect for a transient network blip (e.g. “site unreachable”) — plus a 🧪 Full tests button.
  • ⭐ New +vote command: the link to vote for the bot on top.gg (free, every 12h) in an embed with a button. The docs site also shows a Vote button and a live top.gg badge — voting pushes the bot up the rankings and helps more people find it.
  • 🏆 Leaderboards as images: +leaderboard and +gameleaderboard now render as a slick image (avatars, gold/silver/bronze podium) instead of plain text. And the +level card now uses your profile banner as its background 🎨.
  • 🐛 Faster, more robust leaderboards: the leaderboard image card no longer waits up to 10s for a slow avatar (4s timeout → fallback thumbnail) — the leaderboard shows fast even when Discord's CDN is slow.
  • 🔧 More precise error channel (owner): Discord API errors (“Invalid Form Body”…) now show the exact offending field — fix it at a glance instead of guessing.
  • 🎣 Stronger anti-phishing: the bot now blocks known scam/phishing links using a community blocklist of ~37,000 malicious domains (fake Nitro, token/account theft), auto-updated (every 12h) and kept even when offline — on top of look-alike domain detection. Covers the #1 threat on Discord.
  • 🪖 New +firedrill command (dry-run attack drill): simulates a raid then a nuke and shows exactly what would happen with your current config (thresholds, lockdown, derank, restore), with a readiness score and the list of gaps to fix — with no real action. Test your defenses before the real attack.
  • ⚡ Near-instant leaderboards: an avatar cache (10 min) avoids re-downloading the same images → +leaderboard / +gameleaderboard / +level cards are much faster with almost no CDN timeouts.
  • 🌐 More reliable security alerts: on a transient network blip, owner alerts, antiraid alerts, security-change notifications and +report reports sent to staff now retry automatically instead of being dropped — a critical alert no longer gets lost to a connection hiccup.
  • 💬 More robust +dm: the message is now capped to Discord's limit (4096 chars) → no more failure with a misleading error message on very long text.
  • 🛡️ Secured automatic role grants (anti-escalation): a role with sensitive permissions (Administrator, manage roles/channels, ban…) can no longer be auto-granted via the automatic / self-service paths — join auto-role, verification role (“Verify” button), level rewards, birthday role and the “Bug Hunter” role (+bug). If the role later becomes dangerous — or a booby-trapped same-named role is created — assignment is blocked (and owners notified for auto-role/verification) → an admin can no longer (by mistake or maliciously) grant those rights to every member.
  • 🔒 More honest quarantine: if a role with sensitive permissions sits above the bot's role, the bot cannot remove it — quarantine now clearly flags itself as INCOMPLETE (role(s) not removed, so the member is still dangerous) and tells owners to move the bot's role higher, instead of falsely claiming “all roles removed”.
  • 🎉 Fairer giveaways: at draw time, the winner is picked only from participants still in the server who still have the required role — someone who left, lost the required role or was quarantined after entering can no longer grab the prize.
  • 🔊 Temp voice channels: no more leak: “Join-to-Create” channels are now remembered (persisted) — after a bot restart, empty temp channels are cleaned up and busy ones stay tracked, instead of lingering forever as orphans.
  • 💾 More robust server restore: a slightly corrupted backup no longer aborts the whole recovery — an unreadable permission is treated as “no permission” (fail-safe) and the restore keeps going (remaining roles/channels recreated) instead of stopping dead.
  • 🩺 Hardened health monitor + self-healing (owner): +diag now also tracks database latency, free disk space and detects a 2nd running instance of the bot (cause of the “muted messageCreate” bug). And if the docs site stays unreachable for several checks, the bot auto-redeploys the latest version and notifies you.
  • 🎉 Welcome card image: when a new member joins, the bot posts a slick banner (avatar, “Welcome to {server}”, username, Nth member) — using your server banner as the background if you have one. Falls back to the classic message.
  • 🧹 Memory robustness: full code audit — the impersonation protection now caps its internal anti-spam lists (like the rest of the bot), removing the last source of slow memory growth over very long uptimes. (Security re-checked: no flaws, 0 vulnerabilities.)
  • 🧠 Steadier autonomous learning: the Guardian AI training cycle now resumes its rhythm after a restart (instead of starting a fresh countdown) — no more site panel looking “stuck” on the same cycle after a recent restart; updates come back reliably every ~25 min.
  • 👋 Goodbye card image + +rank: when a member leaves, the bot posts a goodbye banner matching the welcome card (avatar + server banner). Welcome/goodbye cards are previewable and toggleable from +setup → 👋 Welcome & Goodbye. And +level now also answers to +rank / +rang.
  • 🐲 Improved server mascot (+pet): it now alerts the community when it gets hungry, sick, runs away or recovers (in a channel set via +pet channel) — no more letting it waste away in silence while the server sleeps. New +pet play to play with it (boosts its happiness), plus a richer display: evolution countdown + server longevity record.
  • 🚫 More reliable rank blacklist: when a blacklisted member (on this server) gets a role, the bot strips it in bulk and sanctions whoever gave it — it now skips non-removable roles (booster/integration) and only says “sanctioned” when the giver actually was (otherwise it tells you to step in manually).
  • 🔌 Antideco tuned: the abusive voice-disconnect protection now defaults to 5 disconnects / 10 min (instead of 3 / 10s) — it now also catches repetitive harassment (disconnecting someone over and over), not just instant bursts. Toggle it in +setup → Security.
  • 🛠️ Changelog de-duplication: the bot never sends the same changelog point twice anymore — even if a version is re-published or the number is bumped, only the genuinely new points go out to DMs and channels (per-item signature dedup). No more duplicate announcements.
